caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional wooden crucifixion scene consisting of three painted figures mounted on a dark, rectangular base. At the center, there is a figure of Jesus Christ on the cross, with his head tilted to his right and a crown of thorns on his head. His arms are outstretched and nailed to a green cross with red accents at the ends and an INRI plaque at the top. Jesus wears a green and red striped loincloth. Blood marks are visible on his body, highlighting the wounds of crucifixion. To the left of the cross stands a female figure in a long red robe with a blue mantle and a circular head covering with red stripes. To the right of the cross stands a male figure in a long green robe with red accents and a blue headdress. The figures are arranged on a platform featuring a striped border with alternating red, white, and green tones. The background of the drawing is plain and white, with no other elements present.
title: Crucifix
